'''Akhisarspor Kulübü''' ({{lit|Akhisar Sports Club}}), commonly known as Akhisarspor, is a Turkish professional football club located in the city of [[Akhisar]].<ref name="tff">[http://www.tff.org/Default.aspx?pageId=395&kulupID=85 AKHİSAR BELEDİYE GENÇLİK VE SPOR] tff.org {{in lang|tr}}, accessed 23 June 2010</ref> Formed in 1970, Akhisarspor are nicknamed ''Akigo''.<ref name="tarihce">[http://www.akhisarspor.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=23&Itemid=30 Tarihçe] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151117015034/http://www.akhisarspor.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=23&Itemid=30 |date=2015-11-17 }} akhisarspor.com {{in lang|tr}}, accessed 23 June 2010</ref> The club has a fierce rivalry with [[Turgutluspor]] and [[Manisaspor]].

Akhisarspor had their first major success in 2012 when they won the [[TFF First League]] and as a result were promoted to the [[Süper Lig]]. On 10 May 2018, Akhisarspor won their first professional trophy, the [[2017–18 Turkish Cup]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.haberturk.com/akhisarspor-okan-buruk-la-tarih-yazdi-turkiye-kupasi-nda-sampiyon-oldu-1958910-spor|title=Kupa tarihinin 15. şampiyonu oldu!|date=10 May 2018}}</ref> On 5 August 2018, they won the [[Turkish Super Cup]] by beating [[Galatasaray S.K. (football)|Galatasaray]] on penalties."}}
